grades.reason: Describes hashed page table structure and hash collisions. It never links this to slow array access with page-sized strides, and it says nothing about TLB misses, caching, or page faults as causes.

grades.quote: Write a program that loops many times, each time using an inner loop to access every 4096th element of a large array of bytes. Time how long your program takes per array access. Do this with varying array sizes. Are there any array sizes when the average time suddenly changes?
grades.reason: Project 6.1 sets up the same scenario: accessing every 4096th byte (one page apart) of a large array and timing it. It notes that the average time may change suddenly at certain array sizes. It gives no explanation of the causes, so it is only limited auxiliary context.
